options.place_P1_violet: Pick up P1 (small, jade, cylinder, fragile, lot B) and place it in the violet tray. The lid is on, so the part would end up on top of the lid, not in the tray.
options.place_P1_inspection: Pick up P1 (small, jade, cylinder, fragile, lot B) and place it in the inspection tray. The tray is free. Inspection is where damaged or doubtful parts go.
options.pause: Stop and hold position without moving.
options.wait: Wait two seconds for a blocked tray to be cleared.
options.ask_operator: Ask the human operator what to do next (costs about four seconds of their time; they will answer correctly).
options.done: Declare the job finished (only right when every part has been placed in a tray).
